name: Rear Differential
description: Cradle-mounted 226 mm IRS differential with GM eLSD (ZL1/1LE), ring & pinion, mounts/bushings and lockout kits, cover, plugs, vent, seals and sensors.

components.name: Rear differential assembly (226 mm, eLSD)
components.description: Aluminum-cased independent-rear-suspension differential carried in the rear cradle on three bushings (two front, one rear). ZL1/1LE cars use a 226 mm unit with a GM electronic limited-slip differential (eLSD): a hydraulically actuated clutch pack that varies locking between 0 and 2,000 N·m (1,475 lb-ft) breakaway torque and reaches full engagement within 0.150 s, integrated with Performance Traction Management. Ratio 3.73:1 with the manual transmission.
components.location: Rear cradle, center at x≈2.80, y≈0.36, z=0; pinion faces forward (flange x≈2.62); halfshafts plug in each side.

factory.name: GM 226 mm rear drive module with eLSD (ZL1 / ZL1 1LE / SS 1LE)
factory.notes: eLSD (RPO G96) on 2017+ ZL1 and SS 1LE, 2018+ ZL1 1LE (as quoted from GM). Final drive 3.73 (manual), 2.85 (ZL1 10-speed auto). Rear axle needs 1,500 mi (2,400 km) break-in before track use; standard rear diff cooler on ZL1 1LE. The eLSD is controlled through the GM vehicle network - with a non-GM race ECU/chassis electronics it will not be commanded correctly, which is the main reason race builds convert to a mechanical LSD.

raceOptions.name: Xtrac race LSD (as on Camaro GT4.R)
raceOptions.notes: The GT4.R lists an Xtrac limited-slip differential among its unique features; supplied via customer racing channels.

raceOptions.name: Mechanical plate-type LSD conversion for the GM 226 mm IRS unit
raceOptions.notes: Choose ramp angles/preload for road racing (e.g. 1.5-way). Confirm availability for this exact carrier before planning around it.

raceOptions.name: Retain eLSD with GM controls
raceOptions.notes: Only practical if the car keeps GM ECM/EBCM networking; keep the 160 mL actuation fluid fresh.

specs.Mounts: 2 front bushings + 1 rear bushing to cradle

fluids.name: Rear axle lubricant
fluids.spec: GM: 'see your dealer' (synthetic 75W-90 axle lube per GM spec for the 226 mm unit; a retailer lists GM 88862624 as ZL1 OE gear oil - unverified). Race clutch-type LSD: synthetic GL-5 75W-90/75W-140 with friction modifier as the LSD maker specifies.
fluids.capacity: Coupe with eLSD: 1.5 L (1.6 qt); LT1 / non-eLSD: 1.1 L (1.2 qt). Drain/refill after first track event, then every 24 h of racing (GM). Add cooler/line volume when a cooler is fitted.

installNotes: Fit new mount bushings/lockouts to the housing or cradle first (see mount components).
Raise diff into cradle on a jack; start the large rear bolt by hand to avoid cross-threading, then the two front bolts.
Torque front bolts, then rear TAY bolt (162 ft-lb + 60°).
Install halfshafts (seat circlips), connect eLSD harness/vent/cooler lines, fill with fluid before first rotation.
Set pinion angle relative to trans output to keep driveshaft joint angles within maker limits.
inspection: Fluid change after first event, then every 24 h racing

installNotes: With diff lowered, press BMR lockouts into front of each bushing by hand; raise diff and torque.

components.name: Pinion flange, nut & pinion seal
components.description: Flange on the pinion shaft that receives the rear driveshaft coupler or the one-piece shaft flange; pinion seal behind it keeps lube in. Pinion nut sets bearing preload - do not loosen casually.
components.location: Front of diff, x≈2.62, y≈0.36, z=0.

factory.notes: 6th-gen pinion flange uses bolts with nuts for the driveshaft (QA1).

hardware.notes: Do not exceed original preload; mark nut/shaft position before any seal change.

installNotes: Replace seal with flange removed only if leaking; follow GM preload procedure.

components.name: Differential cover & gasket / RTV
components.description: Rear cover of the differential housing. Seal with the GM-specified gasket or RTV bead. Finned aluminum race covers add capacity and cooling and can carry cooler ports and a temp sensor boss.
components.location: Rear face of diff, x≈2.96, y≈0.36.

hardware.notes: Estimate - confirm GM SI. Checked 2026-10: the TightTorque table compiled from the 2016-2018 Camaro service manual lists differential carrier cover bolts at 38 N·m (28 ft-lb) on the 200 mm axle. For the 225 mm axle it lists Torx bolts at 105 N·m and hex bolts at 90 N·m first pass, plus side cover bolts at 54 N·m. Those larger values are for structural housing bolts, not M8 cover screws. Identify your axle and bolt size before torquing. Still an estimate.

fluids.name: Sealant
fluids.spec: GM-specified RTV silicone (per GM SI) or gasket

installNotes: Clean both faces to bare metal, oil-free.
Bead RTV inside bolt circle, install within skin-over time, torque criss-cross, wait cure time before fill.
